issues.issue: Does CSIS have a duty to retain its operational notes, and is the OPS-217 destruction policy consistent with s. 12 of the CSIS Act?
issues.applicant_position: Section 12 requires CSIS to retain operational notes; destroying them under OPS-217 misreads the statute.
issues.respondent_position: Section 12 requires only minimal retention of information, so the destruction policy is valid.
issues.result_quote: We therefore conclude that there is a duty to retain information.

issues.issue: Does CSIS have a duty to disclose all information it holds to the ministers, the designated judge and the named person?
issues.applicant_position: CSIS must disclose all information it holds, as s. 7 of the Charter requires, to the ministers and the judge.
issues.respondent_position: The proceeding is administrative, so no s. 7 duty to disclose applies, as the Federal Court of Appeal held.
issues.result_quote: CSIS should be required to retain all the information in its possession and to disclose it to the ministers and the designated judge.

issues.issue: Was the late disclosure of the interview summary and new allegations a breach that required a remedy?
issues.applicant_position: Late disclosure of the CSIS interview summary and new allegations breached procedural fairness and needs a remedy.
issues.result_quote: the designated judge granted the appropriate remedy for the late disclosure of the interview summary

issues.issue: May the designated judge admit new evidence after the security certificate was issued?
issues.applicant_position: The judge may consider only evidence the ministers had when issuing the certificate, so new evidence must be excluded.
issues.respondent_position: Ministers may submit fresh information under s. 78(e) IRPA, as the designated judge held.
issues.result_quote: In short, the ministers may submit new evidence at any point in the process

issues.issue: Is a stay of proceedings the appropriate remedy?
issues.applicant_position: The certificate proceedings should be stayed because of the destroyed notes and late disclosure.
issues.result_quote: A stay would be an inappropriate remedy here.
